verdict.rationale: Docusign is an e-signature and agreement-management platform, not an incorporation service. End-to-end Delaware incorporation, covering state filing, bylaws and initial board approvals, is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships incorporation filing. Generic signing and templates are at most adjacent tools for signing documents and do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As a founder, I can incorporate a Delaware startup end-to-end online, including the filing, bylaws, and initial board approvals
